ONLY remove all four orange noren curtain panels including their attachment fabric loops, and remove both cream paper lantern bodies and hanging cords. Restore the shoji paper and wood behind the removed curtains, and the unchanged wall/foliage behind removed lanterns. This is a clean background plate so independently animated sprite curtains and lamps can be placed at the same positions. No new objects, no people, no letters or text. Preserve the reference portrait framing and proportions.

GENUINE transparent alpha outside the panel and loop. No shadows outside, no background, no wood, no lanterns, no letters, no text or symbols.
